title: Encoded PowerShell Launched From Outlook
id: 3b1e68f5-0fa0-4b29-9212-6580942a4b5e
status: experimental
description: 'Detects PowerShell processes launched with encoded commands from Outlook'
references:
  - 'https://thedfirmware.lol/t1059-001-encoded-command'
  - 'https://thedfirmware.lol/t1218-011-rundll32'
author: 'Security Operations Center'
date: '2026-04-09'
modified: '2026-04-09'
tags:
  - 'attack.command_and_control'
  - 'attack.defense_evasion'
  - 'attack.t1059.001'
  - 'attack.t1218.011'
  - 'attack.s0106'
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    Image|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-encodedcommand'
  condition: selection_parent AND selection_child
falsepositives:
  - 'Legitimate administrator scripting'
level: high

title: Suspicious DLL Loading from Temp Directory
id: 9f5a87b2-1c3e-4a6f-9b8d-2f4e7c9a1b3d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from temporary directories'
references:
  - 'https://thedfirmware.lol/t1218-011-rundll32'
  - 'https://thedfirmware.lol/t1566-001-spearphishing_attachment'
author: 'Security Operations Center'
date: '2026-04-09'
modified: '2026-04-09'
tags:
  - 'attack.defense_evasion'
  - 'attack.t1218.011'
  - 'attack.t1566.001'
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
fields:
  - 'parent_process_name'
  - 'process_name'
  - 'file_path'
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'C:\Users\'
    CommandLine|contains: '\\AppData\Local\Temp\'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - 'Legitimate software installations'
  - 'Software updates'
level: high
